pages.text:
Bottom field, lot 7. Sunk a trial pit for the cellar of the stone house.

At 26 ft: dressed rock. Not ledge — dressed. A ring cut in it, 9 ft across, a groove N–S through the centre, eight points round. Bearing of the groove: true north to within a quarter degree. I did not set it. Someone set it before any of us.

Ran the line north from the stone with the chain: across the knoll (good ground for a glass), on to the high ground in the trees. Mark the line. Build on it.
